Every record carries the exact `level` it belongs to; no name matching was used. No airfield geometry exists in levels/avg_northern_india.bin itself. 12 airfield(s) and 14 respawn(s) defined by missions for this level lie outside the exported base-map bounds ({'maxX': 0.0, 'maxY': 0.0, 'minX': -4096.0, 'minY': -4096.0}) - they are kept in airfieldsOutsideBaseMap/respawnsOutsideBaseMap with the reason, because the mission data is in the level's land-mesh frame ({'minX': -65536.0, 'maxX': 65536.0, 'minY': -65536.0, 'maxY': 65536.0, 'landCellSizeM': 4096.0, 'cells': [32, 32]}) which is larger than the exported texture for this level.
